messages:
Ayesha Khan: quick q — my calendar shows two orientation events next Wed, one from onboarding@ and one from redwood-calendar@. which one should I keep?
Tom Rivers: keep the onboarding@ one. the calendar sync created duplicates for some domains last week. decline/delete the redwood-calendar invite.
Meg Li: i had the same. i deleted the duplicate but lost the updated agenda that was added later. any way to force the canonical invite to refresh?
Tom Rivers: if you deleted the duplicate, go to the onboarding calendar (link in the onboarding email) and re-accept the event. otherwise toggle calendar subscription: Settings > Calendars > uncheck then recheck Redwood Onboarding.
Ayesha Khan: thanks. also, will the session be recorded and how fast is it posted? APAC folks will need the replay.
Onboarding Bot: Recording info: Session recorded; upload to onboarding S3 bucket within ~45 minutes. Transcript + English captions enabled. Retention: 60 days. For translated captions or extended retention, email onboarding@redwood.com.
Meg Li: can we standardize the subject time label? my invite said PST which confused a few folks — we use PT now.
Tom Rivers: agreed. changed subject to include explicit labels: "09:00 PT / 18:00 CET / 21:30 IST". also added the Zoom link in the description so clients that hide attachments still show it.
Calendar Bot: Automated: Removed duplicate Google Meet from event ID 9f3b, updated title and description per request.
Ayesha Khan: perfect. one last thing — add a short prereq checklist in the description (vpn, slack, laptop image). new hires keep DMing about installs.
Tom Rivers: added checklist and slide Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboard-2026. also added note about APAC alternate live sessions.
Meg Li: thanks all, re-accepted the canonical invite and unsubscribed from the duplicate calendar. see you at orientation! :wave:
